# Asset sources & licences

Every visual and audio asset in this project is **original work generated from code in this repository** or comes from an **openly licensed package**. No stock images were downloaded. Automated downloads from stock sites (Pixabay, Freepik and others) were blocked or could not be verified for licence and watermark status, so the artwork was built procedurally instead. Nothing loads from an external image CDN at runtime.

## Artwork — original, generated by `scripts/build-assets.mjs`

| File(s) | What it is | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `public/assets/invitation/flap*.webp` | Embossed sage botanical card flaps (paper grain, letterpress vines, lotus) | `scripts/art/scenes.mjs → invitationFlap()` |
| `public/assets/invitation/seal.webp` | Antique gold scalloped seal | `seal()` |
| `public/assets/curtains/panel.webp`, `valance*.webp`, `drape.webp` | Champagne silk curtain, swag valance with tassels, tied‑back drape | `curtainPanel()`, `valance()`, `cornerDrape()` |
| `public/assets/backgrounds/garden-*.webp`, `venue-night.webp` | Royal palace, sky, cypress garden, fountain | `gardenSky()`, `gardenMid()` |
| `public/assets/backgrounds/paper.webp` | Tileable ivory paper texture | `paper()` |
| `public/assets/decorations/floral-*.webp` | Rose, blossom and leaf clusters | `floralCorner()`, `floralBorder()` |
| `public/assets/gallery/placeholder-*.svg` | Labelled photo placeholders, to be replaced | `build-assets.mjs` |
| `public/og-image.jpg`, `favicon.svg`, `apple-touch-icon.png` | Share preview and icons (names drawn from the fonts below) | `build-assets.mjs` |

Inline SVG illustrations (17 ceremony scenes, diyas, bells, kalash, toran, Om halo, mandap, couple, ornaments) are original React components in `src/components/art/` and `src/components/Ornaments.jsx`.

Licence: original work for this project. Use it freely for this invitation.

## Music — original

`public/assets/music/mangal-dhun.mp3` is an original composition in the style of Raag Yaman: synthesised santoor (Karplus–Strong), tanpura drone and reverb. It is generated by `scripts/generate-music.mjs` (`npm run music` writes a WAV). The MP3 was encoded at 80 kbps with ffmpeg. There are no samples or recordings, so there are no third‑party rights. To use a different track, put your licensed MP3 in `public/assets/music/` and update `music.src`.
